desc:
🧱 Welcome to Voxel Ragdoll! A blocky ragdoll sandbox where every hit matters. Fight mobs, build traps and cause physics chaos!

💥 Grab, throw and send mobs flying! Watch them stumble, limp and crawl with reactive ragdoll physics.
🧟 Fight zombies, skeletons and creepsters—or mess around with villagers!
⚔️ Unlock swords, bows and guns. Upgrade your armor and enchant your gear.
⛏️ Mine, build and destroy! Experiment with TNT, traps, flowing water and 45 block types.
🍀 Earn emeralds, level up and open lucky blocks for rare rewards!

💾 Builds save in private servers! Public maps reset every 5 minutes.
🎮 PC, Mobile & Console

👍 Like and favorite for more voxel chaos!
